Dallas Critical Mass

Dallas, TX · Social

Dallas Critical Mass is a social group ride in Dallas, TX. It rolls last Friday of the month at 8:00 pm from Dallas Farmers Market. About 10+ miles, 10–12 mph. No-drop.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it's a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before the meet time. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Expect 10–12 mph: you can talk the whole way. It's no-drop: if you fall off the back, someone waits. That's the point of a group ride.
Check
Look at @criticalmassdtx the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Dallas Critical Mass group ride

A monthly social ride of 10-plus miles from the Dallas Farmers Market at an easy 10 to 12 mph. Bring lights, a helmet and water. Riders handle their own repairs.
